units.rawText: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower of Babylon.
units.displayText: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower of Babylon.

spans.text: In the Pantheon of the Reverse Tower of Babylon.

units.rawText: Dum, dum dum, dada—dum, dum dum, dada—
units.displayText: Dum, dum dum, dada—dum, dum dum, dada—

spans.text: Dum, dum dum, dada—dum, dum dum, dada—

units.rawText: The petite girl hums to herself as she moves between the floating stacks of Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: The petite girl hums to herself as she moves between the floating stacks of Sacred Canon.

spans.text: The petite girl hums to herself as she moves between the floating stacks of Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: Now where is it—I remember the greaters are...
units.displayText: Now where is it—I remember the greaters are...

spans.text: Now where is it—I remember the greaters are...

units.rawText: Ah, there it is!
units.displayText: Ah, there it is!

spans.text: Ah, there it is!

units.rawText: The girl stops before a strange-looking book and removes it from its place.
units.displayText: The girl stops before a strange-looking book and removes it from its place.

spans.text: The girl stops before a strange-looking book and removes it from its place.

units.rawText: Found you at last, Judgment. You really were hiding here after all.
units.displayText: Found you at last, Judgment. You really were hiding here after all.

spans.text: Found you at last, Judgment. You really were hiding here after all.

units.rawText: How can you still take up space in the Sacred Canon as the greater Sanctifier "Judgment" when you've already been split up into two intermediates?
units.displayText: How can you still take up space in the Sacred Canon as the greater Sanctifier "Judgment" when you've already been split up into two intermediates?

spans.text: How can you still take up space in the Sacred Canon as the greater Sanctifier "Judgment" when you've already been split up into two intermediates?

units.rawText: Lord Hesperus is so biased. That won't do. Everyone should be treated equally.
units.displayText: Lord Hesperus is so biased. That won't do. Everyone should be treated equally.

spans.text: Lord Hesperus is so biased. That won't do. Everyone should be treated equally.

units.rawText:
Eucharist giggles as she creases the volume's spine, and then she rips the book in two without any hesitation.
The book quickly transforms into two ordinary books, as though this is how it was always meant to be.
units.displayText:
Eucharist giggles as she creases the volume's spine, and then she rips the book in two without any hesitation.
The book quickly transforms into two ordinary books, as though this is how it was always meant to be.

spans.text:
Eucharist giggles as she creases the volume's spine, and then she rips the book in two without any hesitation.
The book quickly transforms into two ordinary books, as though this is how it was always meant to be.

units.rawText: As I thought, this volume was already separated into two, hm? What a shame it wasn't ruined.
units.displayText: As I thought, this volume was already separated into two, hm? What a shame it wasn't ruined.

spans.text: As I thought, this volume was already separated into two, hm? What a shame it wasn't ruined.

units.rawText: You're so powerful, yet you don't have an equally-capable neural cloud to direct it. All you can do is cower behind the title of an intermediate Sanctifier. How sad.
units.displayText: You're so powerful, yet you don't have an equally-capable neural cloud to direct it. All you can do is cower behind the title of an intermediate Sanctifier. How sad.

spans.text: You're so powerful, yet you don't have an equally-capable neural cloud to direct it. All you can do is cower behind the title of an intermediate Sanctifier. How sad.

units.rawText: Eucharist casually flips through the pages. Her mouth curls up, but her eyes are not smiling.
units.displayText: Eucharist casually flips through the pages. Her mouth curls up, but her eyes are not smiling.

spans.text: Eucharist casually flips through the pages. Her mouth curls up, but her eyes are not smiling.

units.rawText: Hm... Crime and Punishment... So they're using equal names to indicate the balance between the two? You're not fooling me.
units.displayText: Hm... Crime and Punishment... So they're using equal names to indicate the balance between the two? You're not fooling me.

spans.text: Hm... Crime and Punishment... So they're using equal names to indicate the balance between the two? You're not fooling me.

units.rawText: No matter how you lie to yourself, you will always be a greater Sanctifier.
units.displayText: No matter how you lie to yourself, you will always be a greater Sanctifier.

spans.text: No matter how you lie to yourself, you will always be a greater Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Crime... Hm, let's call you "Judgment" instead. Now that you've carved out your impurities, will you become a more delicious dish or will you become blander instead...
units.displayText: Crime... Hm, let's call you "Judgment" instead. Now that you've carved out your impurities, will you become a more delicious dish or will you become blander instead...

spans.text: Crime... Hm, let's call you "Judgment" instead. Now that you've carved out your impurities, will you become a more delicious dish or will you become blander instead...

units.rawText: ... Ah, just thinking about it gets me all excited!
units.displayText: ... Ah, just thinking about it gets me all excited!

spans.text: ... Ah, just thinking about it gets me all excited!

units.rawText: She then flips to the page on Punishment. Eucharist's finger flies across each line of text.
units.displayText: She then flips to the page on Punishment. Eucharist's finger flies across each line of text.

spans.text: She then flips to the page on Punishment. Eucharist's finger flies across each line of text.

units.rawText: Hm... Since you're one divided into two, why do you still need something of this level? Looks like things are going to be a little tricky.
units.displayText: Hm... Since you're one divided into two, why do you still need something of this level? Looks like things are going to be a little tricky.

spans.text: Hm... Since you're one divided into two, why do you still need something of this level? Looks like things are going to be a little tricky.

units.rawText: And my eating utensils were confiscated too... What a pain, we can't have a meal without proper cutlery.
units.displayText: And my eating utensils were confiscated too... What a pain, we can't have a meal without proper cutlery.

spans.text: And my eating utensils were confiscated too... What a pain, we can't have a meal without proper cutlery.

units.rawText: Or would it be better to think of how to split them up and eat them one by one?
units.displayText: Or would it be better to think of how to split them up and eat them one by one?

spans.text: Or would it be better to think of how to split them up and eat them one by one?

units.rawText: You may eat at the cafeteria.
units.displayText: You may eat at the cafeteria.

spans.text: You may eat at the cafeteria.

units.rawText: A familiar voice suddenly speaks from behind Eucharist.
units.displayText: A familiar voice suddenly speaks from behind Eucharist.

spans.text: A familiar voice suddenly speaks from behind Eucharist.

units.rawText: Uwah!
units.displayText: Uwah!

spans.text: Uwah!

units.rawText: Eucharist stumbles back as though in shock, smoothly sliding the volumes of Sacred Canon she is holding back into place without any sign of doing so.
units.displayText: Eucharist stumbles back as though in shock, smoothly sliding the volumes of Sacred Canon she is holding back into place without any sign of doing so.

spans.text: Eucharist stumbles back as though in shock, smoothly sliding the volumes of Sacred Canon she is holding back into place without any sign of doing so.

units.rawText: Pardon me, Lady Eucharist, but why are you here?
units.displayText: Pardon me, Lady Eucharist, but why are you here?

spans.text: Pardon me, Lady Eucharist, but why are you here?

units.rawText: Ah, It's Love... I was just hungry and there was nothing to eat in the Chamber of Contemplation, so I ran out—
units.displayText: Ah, It's Love... I was just hungry and there was nothing to eat in the Chamber of Contemplation, so I ran out—

spans.text: Ah, It's Love... I was just hungry and there was nothing to eat in the Chamber of Contemplation, so I ran out—

units.rawText: But I guess I was soooo hungry that I got confused and ended up here instead.
units.displayText: But I guess I was soooo hungry that I got confused and ended up here instead.

spans.text: But I guess I was soooo hungry that I got confused and ended up here instead.

units.rawText: ...I see. Would you like me to lead the way? The operands supply point is in the other direction.
units.displayText: ...I see. Would you like me to lead the way? The operands supply point is in the other direction.

spans.text: ...I see. Would you like me to lead the way? The operands supply point is in the other direction.

units.rawText: No, no, no need for that. I'm awake now. I know where to go.
units.displayText: No, no, no need for that. I'm awake now. I know where to go.

spans.text: No, no, no need for that. I'm awake now. I know where to go.

units.rawText: Eucharist nonchalantly rubs Love's head.
units.displayText: Eucharist nonchalantly rubs Love's head.

spans.text: Eucharist nonchalantly rubs Love's head.

units.rawText: I understand. In that case, please take care of your health. Feel free to contact me if you need anything.
units.displayText: I understand. In that case, please take care of your health. Feel free to contact me if you need anything.

spans.text: I understand. In that case, please take care of your health. Feel free to contact me if you need anything.

units.rawText: I will. Thank you, Love, you're so caring—
units.displayText: I will. Thank you, Love, you're so caring—

spans.text: I will. Thank you, Love, you're so caring—

units.rawText: Eucharist shrugs, then glances behind her one last time before skipping out of the room.
units.displayText: Eucharist shrugs, then glances behind her one last time before skipping out of the room.

spans.text: Eucharist shrugs, then glances behind her one last time before skipping out of the room.

units.rawText: ...[This is Intermediate Sanctifier Love, requesting a backup copy of the entry log for the Pantheon be uploaded to the main tower].
